newsitem.title: USA: JAMES RIVER SAYS U.S. CLEARS FORT HOWARD DEAL.
newsitem.headline: JAMES RIVER SAYS U.S. CLEARS FORT HOWARD DEAL.

text.p: James River Corp said on Thursday the U.S. Department of Justice cleared the company's $5.8 billion merger with Fort Howard Corp.
This clearance follows the completion of a similar regulatory review earlier this week in the U.K., James River said.
The merger, announced on May 5, still needs the approval of a majority of the shareholders of both companies, James River added.
Special meetings of both companies' shareholders are scheduled for August 12, 1997.
If approved by shareholders, the merger will close as soon as possible after August 12, the company said.
